purpose: Audit varied public NHS website templates and an anonymous navigation route to general walking information; exclude diagnosis, accounts, booking and personal health submissions.

pages.task: Find the Healthy living navigation from the NHS homepage.
Browse public Healthy living topics and find exercise information.
Find the Walking for health guide in the exercise listing.
pages.sampleRationale: Nested subject listing with mixed links to articles and media.

pages.task: Read the public walking information page without giving symptoms or personal data.
pages.sampleRationale: Long-form evergreen advice with review dates; no diagnosis task.

pages.task: Find the Strength and Flex instructional videos and their accompanying information without playing media.
Read analytics-cookie purposes and available settings; no personal information entry.
Find the editorial review process and responsibility for published health information.

journeys.task: Reject analytics cookies, navigate through Healthy living and Exercise, and reach the complete Walking for health article as an anonymous English desktop reader.

contextScopes.access-barriers: Anonymous English readers using a desktop browser with pointer input and JavaScript, 1440 by 1000 CSS pixels: start at https://www.nhs.uk/, reject analytics cookies, follow Healthy living > Exercise > Walking for health, and reach the article heading and full reading content. No account, symptom input, booking or submitted health data. Keyboard-only, assistive-technology and constrained-device completion are outside this assessment scope.
contextScopes.content-lifecycle: NHS Healthy living exercise editorial collection, specifically Walking for health and Strength and Flex how-to videos, as publicly presented on 2026-11-06: assess the published review schedule, responsible editorial/clinical roles and evidence of an applied review/update/archive decision; retain historical material when it has continuing user value. No CMS history or backend deletion scope.
contextScopes.data-minimization: Anonymous visitor analytics-cookie choice on the public NHS website on 2026-11-06: inspect accept/reject and settings choices, analytics-data categories and stated purpose across the homepage banner, cookie details and public privacy notice. No health-data task, identity form submission, NHS login or NHS App processing. Retention enforcement and cross-service propagation cannot be established by this observation.

contextEvidence.scope: Anonymous English readers using a desktop browser with pointer input and JavaScript, 1440 by 1000 CSS pixels: start at https://www.nhs.uk/, reject analytics cookies, follow Healthy living > Exercise > Walking for health, and reach the article heading and full reading content. contextEvidence.limitations: Agent pointer walkthrough; not representative-user research, keyboard-only test or full accessibility audit.
